$comment: Runtime-resolved edges that static scanning cannot see. Each rule names the source file and how to resolve its target. Rules are data, not code.

rules.reason: launcher selects the UI module from the UIS registry by AGENT_UI; default is electron
loadEngine() probes core/loops/<name>/index.js then core/loops/<name>.js; default engine is node-graph, linear is the frozen reference engine
loadNodes() scans core/loops/nodes/*/registry.json and requires each node entry
loadNodes() also scans core/loops/builtins/*/registry.json as builtin nodes
loadTools() scans tools/*/registry.json and requires each declared entry (default run.js)
